title: DARPA man talking to a computer with his mind

tellings.quote: He said, "I'm talking to this machine with my mind." [laughter]

plain: Around 1974, a man at DARPA, the Pentagon's research agency, is said to have told a visitor, "I'm talking to this machine with my mind." The UFO researcher Grant Cameron tells Michels this as something a man named Bob Emenegger told him, and both laugh at the line. If true, it would mean the military was linking minds to computers decades before such work became public.
